purpose: certify, before any registered seed is evolved, that the implemented IOTA-MIN-L0 is the law in minimal_law.json and has the class-relevant structure that the predictions in iota_spreading.json assume
outcome_boundary: Stage A may evolve only disclosed synthetic states (hand-built media of at most 9x9x9 sites with a declared fresh pattern); it may not draw a registered random medium, sweep rho, or compute any Stage S observable

canonical_reference.use: provenance for the constants v = 2 and a0 = 7 and for the ladder; the canonical law is not run in this version

questions.design_answer: yes: any state in which no active site borders a fresh site
questions.required_check: synthetic witnesses: a seed with no fresh neighbours (absorbed at tick 0); a stranded active site enclosed by depleted sites

questions.design_answer: exact: 'no active site has a fresh face neighbour' (minimal_law.json absorbing_certificate)
questions.required_check: on 1000 synthetic states, certificate true implies the next tick leaves the state unchanged bit for bit, and certificate false implies at least one transfer

questions.design_answer: no in L0 (no exogenous channel; depleted sites never receive); yes in L1 (reactivation of depleted sites)
questions.required_check: the L1 synthetic test in iota_spreading.json hypotheses.L1_analytic

questions.design_answer: depletion is permanent and is the only state left in the vacated medium; it is the immunization condition of dynamic percolation
questions.required_check: code inspection that no other field exists

questions.design_answer: the ledger is conserved but amplitude never moves between active sites in L0, so no conserved field drives activity in visited regions; the budget acts only as a local service capacity at the front
questions.required_check: ledger residual exactly 0 on all synthetic states

questions.design_answer: 1 (face6, one quantum per source per tick)
questions.required_check: light-cone test: no site beyond Chebyshev distance t from the seed is touched by tick t

questions.design_answer: the random medium is quenched disorder by design; it is exactly the site-occupation disorder of percolation, which is why the percolation threshold is the reference. No parity constraint.
L0: zero. L1: r per depleted-neighbour pair per tick

rho is the occupation probability of the medium and cannot be absorbed into a time rescaling; below the site-percolation threshold every run is absorbed (minimal_law.json facts_by_construction), so a subcritical regime exists on the registered path

prediction_record.rule: copied unchanged into the Stage A answer commit; no prediction may be revised after any Stage S data exist

L0.H1_threshold: registered as a two-sided question ('equal' versus 'budget_shifted'); no direction is predicted, because the design argument cuts both ways: near p_c the fresh cluster is tenuous, so most activated sites have few fresh neighbours and a budget of about 3 usually suffices, but rare high-branching sites can strand parts of a thin cluster

deliverable: experiments/dp_persistence/ICP-DP-PERSISTENCE-001/structural_audit_answers.json plus the synthetic witness states and test log, committed before Stage S opening
